body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Slowed 2 and suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Learn whether the target has more Action or Reaction Dice remaining.
On a hit, it must burn 1 die before its next voluntary movement until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Fracture
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, you may move 1 unit after the target next moves before your next turn.
